verdict.rationale: Beyond Coinbase, x402 governance formally moved to the Linux Foundation with a vendor-neutral Technical Steering Committee and Governing Board seated by AWS, Google, Visa, Mastercard, Cloudflare, Stripe, Shopify and others, and independent third-party implementers are documented in the wild (httpay.xyz running 124 x402 endpoints, Apiosk building an x402 payment gateway, Cloudflare proposing new payment schemes), satisfying 'at least two independent parties implement it.' Missing for 10: deeper technical evidence that these third parties implement core protocol components (e.g., alternative facilitators) rather than just using Coinbase's facilitator, and independent audits confirming interoperability across implementations.
